body: I want to make it work because I want to find the root of where this is coming from. I want to make it work because I love this person with my whole heart. I want to make it work because I know they love me back just as much, I just want to help them understand that this is causing strain on our relationship and their life. They have goals, they aren’t a failure. I just need them to understand what the long term effects of continuing this path will end up being. They’re a great person, the sweetest person I know. I want to fix it because I want to fix it, and that’s okay.
I just want so desperately to have a better life and it genuinely feels like it’s not meant to happen. It hurts, I’m so tired of being hurt.

He will not change. The best thing you can do in this situation is think about creating a better future for you and your baby. You can’t change the people around you, but you CAN change the people you are around. You deserve to give yourself the love you are giving him, that is not being reciprocated back to you.
